title: The Legend of the White Snake

scenes.text: The Legend of the White Snake is a famous Chinese folktale that has been told and retold for centuries, captivating audiences with its blend of romance, magic and morality.
The story revolves around a complex relationship between a white snake spirit, Bai Suzhen, and a young man Xu Xian.
According to the legend, Bai Suzhen, a snake who has cultivated herself into a beautiful woman, falls in love with Xu Xian, a kind-hearted pharmacist.
They marry, unaware of Bai Suzhen's true identity.
Their love is genuine and deep, but it is put to the test when a monk, Fahai, who knows Bai Suzhen's real form, decides to separate them to uphold the natural order.
Fahai tricks Xu Xian into giving Bai Suzhen a special wine during the Dragon Boat Festival, which causes her to reveal her true form.
Shocked by discovering that his wife is a snake, Xu Xian faints and later dies from the shock.
Bai Suzhen, desperate to save her husband, braves numerous trials to acquire a magical herb that revives him.
However, the tale reaches its climax when Fahai captures Bai Suzhen and imprisons her under the Leifeng Pagoda.
Years later, her son with Xu Xian, who is unaware of his mother's fate, becomes a top scholar and eventually frees her.
The Legend of the White Snake explores themes of love, loyalty, and the conflict between supernatural beings and the human world.
It is a poignant narrative that questions the boundaries of love and the sacrifices one is willing to make for it.
